items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: Well, I played on the Hillsberg full season and then I was only called in as extra strings were needed.

ctx.x: And Alexander Hillsberg. What did you do?

Oh, Alexander Hillsberg. He's conducting the orchestra right now, huh? Well, I played on the Hillsberg full season and then I was only called in as extra strings were needed. But fortunately, uh, I, Hillsberg was one of the conductors who didn't pick on me and we got along real fine together. He, of course, he used to be the concert maister with the Philadelphia orchestra, you know. Fine violinist. And, uh, he has that nice smile, you know, how are you? You know, grin. Have you been practicing this summer? You…
Well, give me the full treatment on that, man. Don't go back.
